question: Can complete registered reference supervision be transferred through frozen RGB features into a query-bounded endpoint mask whose endpoints are actual supported query pixels?

source_selector.candidate_order: provider OBB area descending, then scan IDs and instance ID

frame_rules.frame_ranking: visible vertices, visible ratio, projected area, image margin, then earlier frame

sam_masker.name: facebook/sam2.1-hiera-small
sam_masker.component_selection: connected component maximizing positive-prompt hits, then area, then stable label
sam_masker.extent_decoder: convex hull of selected supported query-mask pixels
sam_masker.endpoint_decoder: actual selected-mask pixels with minimum and maximum projection on the supported-pixel principal axis

partial_reference.description: Positive reference support is restricted to the positive-edge quarter; the rest of the full door is ignored rather than labelled background.

complete_reference.description: Positive reference support covers the complete registered reference door.

transfer_field.similarity: cosine similarity between frozen normalized DINO patch features
transfer_field.positive_candidates: mutual nearest-neighbour query/reference matches whose reference patch is inside arm supervision
transfer_field.negative_candidates: dense nearest-reference matches whose reference patch is outside the complete reference door
transfer_field.prompt_order: cosine descending then stable query patch index

allowed: reference RGB plus registered reference supervision
query_input_contract.note: Forbidden query fields remain evaluator-only and are read only after both RGB predictions are sealed in memory.

stop_rule: Freeze one new registered pair before reading RGB, run the bounded decoder once, and do not tune prompts, thresholds, model choice, component selection, decoder, frames, or gate after replay.
claim_boundary: One real indoor 3RScan stable-door Development canary. A pass would establish only that complete registered reference supervision can seed a query-bounded learned RGB endpoint mask on one held-out rescan. It does not establish multi-scene generalization, exact physical identity under distractors, doorway aperture, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.
